recent_learnings.lesson: Manual triggers system: 8 on-demand commands replacing former cron jobs.
Unified daemon pattern: self-looping Python process with SIGTERM handler, log rotation, 5min interval.
Eliminated all 54 cron jobs - replaced with unified daemon and manual triggers. Cron had 16% success rate.
Use patch instead of write_file for surgical material fixes in large HTML files. Preserves structure and reduces write overhead.
Check playwright installation with 'which playwright' before using browser tools. If missing, install with 'npx playwright install chromium'.
browser_navigate blocks file:// URLs. Always serve local HTML files via 'python3 -m http.server <port>' before attempting browser navigation.
Hermes expects chromium_headless_shell-1217 but 'playwright install chromium' may install a different build. Use 'npx playwright install' to match the version in hermes's playwright dependency.
Headless chromium cannot render MeshPhysicalMaterial (three.js r128). Use MeshPhongMaterial or MeshLambertMaterial for WebGL compatibility in browser_vision screenshots.
Repeated error 'id confusion' occurred 2 times. Add to error_patterns_predictive.
cat >> file << 'EOF' is reliable for appending multi-line content. Use 'EOF' (quoted) to prevent variable expansion.
